# graph-manager server: run options in the start body, argv, extra arguments and per-workspace run defaults

## What to build

`POST /api/runs/:ws` accepts an optional, strict `options` object and turns it into graph-execution flags, so a run can be started from graph-manager with human review, no merge, a model, a concurrency and every engine override flag (the engine already has `--attempts`, `--fix-passes`, `--validation-rounds`, `--validate-at task|end`, `--validate-parallel` / `--no-validate-parallel` and `--idle-timeout <minutes>`, plus the older `--human-review` / `--no-human-review`, `--no-merge`, `--model`, `--concurrency`). An `extraArgs` string is split with shell-style quoting (the engine's own `splitArgs`) and appended after the option flags; flags graph-manager sets itself are refused with 400. A successful start saves the request for that workspace in `graph-manager.json` under a new `runDefaults` key, and `GET /api/workspaces/:id/run-defaults` returns it (or `{}`), so the Start run drawer (a later task) can prefill the form. The pure argv builder lives in a new file `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runoptions.ts` so the drawer's command preview can be checked against it.

Spec: `docs/prd/run-options.md` (Jira KAN-89), section "Server". Two other features are built in parallel from the same commit and also edit `routes/runs.ts` (start body, env) and `store.ts` (`dataSchema`). Keep edits there **additive**: add the `options` key to `startBody`, replace only the two argv lines 84–85 of `routes/runs.ts`, append the store save and the new GET route; add `runDefaults` as a new key at the end of `dataSchema`. Do not reorder, rename or reformat existing code.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.ts` (lines 12–19) — `PROVIDERS` and `startBody` (zod); (74–110) the start handler: path checks, `const args = [...]` at 84 and the `--concurrency` push at 85 (the lines this task replaces), env (86–89), `execa` (90–99), 400 with `exitCode`/`output` (100–105), 201 (106–109).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/inspect.ts` (lines 66–73) — a `GET /api/workspaces/:id/...` route: `resolveWorkspace(ctx.config.workspacesDir, req.params.id)`, 404 `{ error: "unknown workspace" }`. Mirror it for `run-defaults`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts` (lines 8–26) — `dataSchema`; (72–90) `DataStore.update(fn)`: applies `fn` to a copy, validates with `dataSchema`, writes atomically.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts` (lines 52–71) — the error handler: a thrown `ZodError` becomes 400 `{ error: "<path>: <message>" }`, so `startBody.parse` failures (unknown option key, bad number) are 400 already.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/args.ts` (lines 1–59) — `splitArgs(value, name)`: POSIX-style words, nothing expanded; throws `Error("<name>: unterminated double quote")` etc.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/api.ts` (lines 1–14) — graph-manager's only import surface of the engine (`graph-execution/api`, resolved to `packages/graph-execution/dist/api.js`, so the engine must be built: `npm run build -w graph-execution`).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.test.ts` (lines 1–106, 140–180) — route tests: a git workspace under `<dir>/ws/github/octo/hello` with the engine's `diamond` fixture and `spec.md`, `buildApp(testConfig(dir, { graphExecutionBin: BIN }), ...)`, login, `api(method, url, body)`, `started` pids killed in `afterEach`, `it.skipIf(!built)` for real runs.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/test-helpers.ts` — `appWithLogin(overrides)` returns `{ app, cookie, config, store, cleanup }` for `app.inject` tests; `testConfig(dir, overrides)`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/workspaces.ts` (lines 57–70) — `resolveWorkspace` needs `<workspacesDir>/<forge>/<owner>/<repo>` to be a directory with a `.git` entry.
- `apps/graph-manager/README.md` (line 72) — the Runs bullet that describes Start run.

## Patterns to follow

**Zod body + 400 on a semantic error (routes/runs.ts:77–81):**
```ts
const body = startBody.parse(req.body ?? {});
const tasksDir = insideWorkspace(ws, body.tasksDir);
if (!tasksDir) return reply.code(400).send({ error: `tasksDir: ${body.tasksDir} is not a folder inside the workspace` });
```

**Store update (routes/runs.test.ts:118–120 and store.ts:73):**
```ts
await ctx.store.update((d) => {
  d.prs[`${WS}/20261106-120000-abcd`] = { ... };
});
```

**Fake engine bin for argv tests:** `engineCommand` (routes/runs.ts:44–46) runs any `.mjs`/`.js` bin through `node`, so a test can point `graphExecutionBin` at a script that records its argv:
```js
// <dir>/fake-ge.mjs
import { writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
writeFileSync(new URL("./argv.json", import.meta.url), JSON.stringify(process.argv.slice(2)));
console.log("Started run gm-20261107-120000-abcd in the background: http://127.0.0.1:1/");
```

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/api.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: one new line, appended after the existing exports: `export { splitArgs } from "./providers/args.js";`
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run build -w graph-execution`

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runoptions.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  ```ts
  import { splitArgs } from "graph-execution/api";
  import { z } from "zod";

  /** The Start run options (docs/prd/run-options.md). An absent field sends no flag: the repo config or the engine default decides. */
  export const runOptionsSchema = z.strictObject({
    humanReview: z.boolean().optional(),
    merge: z.boolean().optional(),
    model: z.string().max(200).regex(/^[^\s-]\S*$/, "must be a model name").optional(),
    concurrency: z.number().int().min(1).max(64).optional(),
    attempts: z.number().int().min(1).optional(),
    fixPasses: z.number().int().min(0).optional(),
    validationRounds: z.number().int().min(0).optional(),
    validateAt: z.enum(["task", "end"]).optional(),
    validateParallel: z.boolean().optional(),
    idleTimeoutMinutes: z.number().min(0).optional(),
    extraArgs: z.string().max(4000).optional(),
  });
  export type RunOptionsBody = z.infer<typeof runOptionsSchema>;
  ```
- `export function optionArgs(o: RunOptionsBody): string[]` — the flags in this fixed order (the order the drawer's preview prints; it puts `--no-merge` before `--human-review` as the spec's acceptance example does):
  1. `merge === false` → `--no-merge` (`true`/absent: nothing; merging is the engine default)
  2. `humanReview === true` → `--human-review`; `false` → `--no-human-review`
  3. `model` → `--model <m>`
  4. `concurrency` → `--concurrency <n>`
  5. `attempts` → `--attempts <n>`
  6. `fixPasses` → `--fix-passes <n>`
  7. `validationRounds` → `--validation-rounds <n>`
  8. `validateAt` → `--validate-at <task|end>`
  9. `validateParallel === true` → `--validate-parallel`; `false` → `--no-validate-parallel`
  10. `idleTimeoutMinutes` → `--idle-timeout <n>` (`String(n)`, so `0.5` stays `0.5`)
- `export const RESERVED_FLAGS = ["--web", "--web-serve", "--resume", "--run", "--spec", "--provider", "--help", "-h", "--version", "-v"] as const;` (`--help`/`--version` added because they would make the CLI exit 0 without starting a run).
- `export class ExtraArgsError extends Error {}` and `export function splitExtraArgs(value: string | undefined): string[]`:
  - `undefined` or blank → `[]`.
  - `splitArgs(value, "extra arguments")`; rethrow its `Error` as `ExtraArgsError` with the same message (e.g. `extra arguments: unterminated single quote`).
  - For each word: `name = word.startsWith("--") ? word.split("=")[0] : word`; if `RESERVED_FLAGS` includes `name`, or it is the first word and does not start with `-` (a positional = a second tasks folder), throw `new ExtraArgsError(\`extra arguments: ${name} is set by graph-manager\`)`.
- `export function startArgs(body: { tasksDir: string; spec: string; provider: string; options?: RunOptionsBody }): string[]` → `[body.tasksDir, "--spec", body.spec, "--provider", body.provider, ...optionArgs(o), ...splitExtraArgs(o.extraArgs), "--web"]` with `o = body.options ?? {}`.
- **GOTCHA**: this file is server code (tsconfig.json, NodeNext): relative imports need `.js` suffixes; `graph-execution/api` has types in `dist/api.d.ts`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck -w graph-manager`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** (additive):
  - Import: `import { ExtraArgsError, runOptionsSchema, startArgs, type RunOptionsBody } from "../runoptions.js";`
  - `startBody` (14–19): keep `concurrency` as is (compatibility) and add `options: runOptionsSchema.optional(),` as the last key.
  - Replace lines 84–85 only:
    ```ts
    // The top-level `concurrency` is kept for older clients; `options.concurrency` wins when both are given.
    const options: RunOptionsBody = { ...(body.concurrency !== undefined ? { concurrency: body.concurrency } : {}), ...body.options };
    let args: string[];
    try {
      args = startArgs({ tasksDir: body.tasksDir, spec: body.spec, provider: body.provider, options });
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof ExtraArgsError) return reply.code(400).send({ error: err.message });
      throw err;
    }
    ```
  - Before the final `return reply.code(201)...` (line 109): save the choices for the workspace; a failed save must not fail the start:
    ```ts
    await ctx.store
      .update((d) => {
        d.runDefaults[ws.id] = { provider: body.provider, tasksDir: body.tasksDir, spec: body.spec, options };
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => req.log.warn({ err }, "could not save the run defaults"));
    ```
  - Append a route at the end of `runsRoutes`:
    ```ts
    app.get<{ Params: { id: string } }>("/api/workspaces/:id/run-defaults", async (req, reply) => {
      const ws = workspaceOr404(ctx, req.params.id);
      if (!ws) return reply.code(404).send({ error: "unknown workspace" });
      return ctx.store.get().runDefaults[ws.id] ?? {};
    });
    ```
- **GOTCHA**: the spawn keeps `--web` last; the old code pushed `--concurrency` after `--web` — that order is gone on purpose.
- **GOTCHA**: keep the existing order (body parse → path checks → args). A reserved extra argument with valid paths answers 400 `{ error: "extra arguments: --web is set by graph-manager" }` and never spawns the CLI.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck -w graph-manager`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: a new last key in `dataSchema` (after `revokedSessions`, line 25):
  ```ts
  /** The last Start run choices per workspace id, written when a run starts (docs/prd/run-options.md). */
  runDefaults: z
    .record(
      z.string(),
      z.object({ provider: z.string(), tasksDir: z.string(), spec: z.string(), options: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()).default({}) }),
    )
    .default({}),
  ```
- **GOTCHA**: keep `options` loose (`z.record(z.string(), z.unknown())`) here: a stricter schema would make the server refuse to start on a `graph-manager.json` written by another version. The drawer sanitizes what it loads. Existing files without `runDefaults` keep loading (`.default({})`).

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runoptions.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** (node env, pure):
  - `optionArgs({})` → `[]`.
  - `startArgs({ tasksDir: "diamond", spec: "spec.md", provider: "fake", options: { humanReview: true, merge: false, fixPasses: 2 } })` → `["diamond", "--spec", "spec.md", "--provider", "fake", "--no-merge", "--human-review", "--fix-passes", "2", "--web"]` (**regression, KAN-89 acceptance**).
  - Every option set: `{ merge: false, humanReview: false, model: "opus", concurrency: 5, attempts: 1, fixPasses: 0, validationRounds: 2, validateAt: "end", validateParallel: false, idleTimeoutMinutes: 0.5, extraArgs: "--foo bar" }` → `--no-merge --no-human-review --model opus --concurrency 5 --attempts 1 --fix-passes 0 --validation-rounds 2 --validate-at end --no-validate-parallel --idle-timeout 0.5 --foo bar --web` after the provider; `merge: true` adds nothing; `validateParallel: true` → `--validate-parallel`.
  - `splitExtraArgs("--model 'a b'")` → `["--model", "a b"]`; `splitExtraArgs("  ")` → `[]`.
  - `splitExtraArgs` throws `ExtraArgsError` with message `extra arguments: --web is set by graph-manager` for `"--web"`, `extra arguments: --spec is set by graph-manager` for `"--spec x.md"` and `"--spec=x.md"`, and for `"--resume"`, `"--run x"`, `"--provider claude"`, `"--web-serve"`, `"--help"`; `"other-tasks"` (positional first) → `extra arguments: other-tasks is set by graph-manager`; `"'unterminated"` → `extra arguments: unterminated single quote`.
  - `runOptionsSchema.safeParse({ nope: 1 }).success` is false; `{ concurrency: 65 }`, `{ attempts: 0 }`, `{ fixPasses: -1 }`, `{ idleTimeoutMinutes: -1 }`, `{ validateAt: "sometimes" }`, `{ model: "--web" }` all fail.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runoptions.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** with `appWithLogin({ graphExecutionBin: <dir>/fake-ge.mjs })` (write the fake bin from "Patterns" into a `tempDir()` first) and `app.inject`; workspace `github~octo~hello` = `mkdir -p <config.workspacesDir>/github/octo/hello/{.git,diamond}` plus `spec.md` in it:
  - POST `{ tasksDir: "diamond", spec: "spec.md", provider: "fake", options: { humanReview: true, merge: false, fixPasses: 2 } }` → 201; `argv.json` equals `["diamond", "--spec", "spec.md", "--provider", "fake", "--no-merge", "--human-review", "--fix-passes", "2", "--web"]`.
  - Top-level `concurrency: 3` with `options.concurrency: 5` → argv has `--concurrency 5` once; top-level alone → `--concurrency 3` before `--web`.
  - `options: { extraArgs: "--web" }` → 400 `{ error: "extra arguments: --web is set by graph-manager" }` and `argv.json` was not written (delete it before the call); `"--spec x.md"` → 400 naming `--spec`; `"--model 'a b'"` → 201 with `"--model", "a b"` as two argv entries just before `--web`.
  - `options: { bogus: true }` → 400; `options: { attempts: 0 }` → 400.
  - `GET /api/workspaces/github~octo~hello/run-defaults` → `{}` before any start; after the first successful start → `{ provider: "fake", tasksDir: "diamond", spec: "spec.md", options: { humanReview: true, merge: false, fixPasses: 2 } }`; a 400 start does not change it; `GET /api/workspaces/github~octo~missing/run-defaults` → 404; without the cookie → 401.
  - `store.get().runDefaults["github~octo~hello"]` holds the same object (the data file is the source of truth).

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** one real-run test next to the existing one (lines 140–180), `it.skipIf(!built)`, 120 s timeout: POST `{ tasksDir: "diamond", spec: "spec.md", provider: "fake", options: { humanReview: true, attempts: 1, fixPasses: 0 } }` → 201; push the pid from `web.json` into `started`; poll `GET ${viewUrl}state` until `review?.waiting === true` (the run page's view state); then read `<wsDir>/.graph-execution/<runId>/state.json`: `humanReview: true`, `overrides: { attempts: 1, fixPasses: 0 }`. The `afterEach` kills the run process.

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/README.md`

- Line 72 (Runs bullet): say that Start run also has the run options (human review, merge, model, concurrency, and under **More options** attempts, fix passes, validation rounds, when to validate, parallel validation, idle timeout and extra arguments), that an option left at "Repo default" sends no flag, and that the last choices are remembered per workspace on the server (`runDefaults` in `graph-manager.json`).
- Line 48 (`GM_DATA_DIR` row): mention the saved Start run choices next to tokens and the session secret.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `POST /api/runs/:ws` with `options: { humanReview: true, merge: false, fixPasses: 2 }` spawns `<tasks> --spec <spec> --provider fake --no-merge --human-review --fix-passes 2 --web`.
- [ ] An absent option sends no flag; `humanReview: false` sends `--no-human-review`; `merge: false` sends `--no-merge`.
- [ ] `options.extraArgs: "--web"` and `"--spec x.md"` give 400 `{ error: "extra arguments: <flag> is set by graph-manager" }`; `"--model 'a b'"` passes `--model` and `a b` as two arguments, after the option flags and before `--web`.
- [ ] Unknown option keys and out-of-range numbers give 400; the top-level `concurrency` still works and loses to `options.concurrency`.
- [ ] After a successful start, `GET /api/workspaces/:id/run-defaults` returns `{ provider, tasksDir, spec, options }`; before, `{}`; unknown workspace 404.
- [ ] A fake run started with `humanReview: true` reaches "waiting for your review" (`review.waiting` in the view state).
- [ ] `npm test -w graph-manager` passes.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run build -w graph-execution
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/runoptions.test.ts src/server/routes/runoptions.test.ts src/server/routes/runs.test.ts src/server/store.test.ts
```
